description: Read-only: checks the SJ Storage public availability feed for unit types, sizes, monthly rent, deposits and open counts. Optional unit type or size matches the current feed or the published sizes. A published size absent from the feed is not listed as open right now. The snapshot is shared for about 60 seconds. Nothing is held or reserved; the reserve step rechecks. Missing types are not treated as zero.

unit.description: Type code, label or size from the feed, or a published size such as 8x20 or 12x30. Without a filter, all reported types are listed.

name: check_availability
